# LLM-customer check: a model adds an endpoint from the docs alone
<!-- GENERATED from the Phrase Board (issue #137, sha256:6affeaf622b942afb4a66dd22dddf0bb8bd9f2e4e5676d59c5ba65c9f8589193). Do not edit this file: edit the issue. -->


- **Status:** Ready
- **Shape:** Story
- **Type:** data (end to end check; replaces card 011)
- **Milestone:** Usable v1 (shortest path to a real prototype)
- **Source:** Product direction, 2026-10-27 (reach a real prototype first) and Decider D86 (Codex No with fixes that were adopted, Grok Support-it): the shortest path to a real multi-endpoint app written in Phrase that compiles, builds, passes its generated specs and runs. Replaces the dependency chain of cards 008 to 012 and 057, which pulled in the base-library line and a deferred rule card.
- **Depends on:** 135, 136
- **Story:** As Ari, I want a model that never saw the Tasks app to add a new endpoint with specs from GRAMMAR.md and the cheat sheet alone, so that I know the docs are enough for a new user.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given a cold model with only docs/GRAMMAR.md and docs/CHEATSHEET.md, When it is asked to add one new endpoint with specs to Tasks.phrase, Then the result compiles, builds without warnings and all specs pass (generated specs, new and old)
  2. Given the run, When it is recorded, Then docs/usable-v1/llm-check.json holds the model, attempts, tokens and the pass result (totals only)
  3. Given a failure of the check, When it is read, Then it names the missing documentation or language gap as a card
